title: The capital feast continues to intensify: Sequoia Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and other giants plan to invest billions of dollars more in Anthropic's IPO
excerpt: The rapid advance of the artificial intelligence race is taking center stage in a new act in the capital markets. According to people familiar with the matter,
content_html:
The rapid advance of the artificial intelligence race is taking center stage in a new act in the capital markets. According to people familiar with the matter, as AI startup Anthropic PBC continues to show strong momentum and commercial potential, several of its core early venture capital backers are planning to inject more funds in the company's upcoming initial public offering (IPO).

Top-tier capital continues to double down: casting a vote for the future with real money

In the current global competitive landscape for large models, Anthropic has earned high recognition from capital thanks to its outstanding performance in cutting-edge technology R&D and the enterprise market.

The people familiar with the matter said that several well-known institutions, including Sequoia Capital, Iconiq, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Accel, and Altimeter Capital Management, are now planning to jointly purchase shares worth as much as several billion dollars in Anthropic's IPO process. This move clearly shows that these top-tier institutions, which have already been deeply involved in earlier investments, remain highly confident in and firmly supportive of Anthropic's long-term strategic value in the future.
